title: Chitin Knock
description: A single FM-synth percussion hit in the mid register, sculpted dry and clicky with a steep pitch-envelope knock. Over 16 cycles the FM index, harmonicity steps, and knock depth morph the hit from a hollow wooden tick into a metallic alien chirp and back.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("c4 ~ <c4 eb4> [~ c4] c4 ~ [c4 g4] ~").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(3, 11)).fmh("<2 3.5 1.5 5>/4")
    .penv(sine.slow(24).range(14, 30)).pattack(0.001).pdecay(saw.slow(13).range(0.03, 0.07))
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.09).sustain(0).release(0.02)
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(1800, 5200)).resonance(9).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.002).lpdecay(0.05)
    .shape(0.3).coarse("<1 1 2 1>/8")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(0.02, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.2).crush(7))
    .room(0.18).gain(0.9)
)
